# Weblets — lets make website together
> Premier full-stack web development agency specializing in bespoke high-converting websites, e-commerce platforms, commercial niche templates, and express 48-hour turnarounds.

- **Pricing Spectrum**: Fixed-price packages from ₹4,999 ($149) to ₹49,999 ($1,499) with zero hidden fees and 100% full source code ownership.
- **Delivery SLAs**: 48 to 72 hours for template customizations; 5 to 7 business days for bespoke web engineering sprints.

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Bespoke Business Websites**: High-performance digital flagships engineered with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
2. **High-Converting Landing Pages**: Conversion-rate-optimized sales funnels with interactive lead intake.
3. **E-Commerce & WhatsApp Ordering**: Instant direct-to-WhatsApp catalog checkout and Razorpay/Stripe integration.
4. **Live Commercial Niche Demos**: 12+ pre-built, production-ready templates for Restaurants, Salons, Gyms, Clinics, Cafes, Real Estate, and LMS.
5. **Real-Time Project Sprint Tracking**: Dedicated 6-stage engineering roadmap tracker accessible with Order ID.
6. **Mobile Applications**: Turnkey PWA and native Android APK support.
